pricing.details: Faces + Face Generator 180 €/year — 15 downloads/month, unlimited face generations, no watermarks, commercial use. Humans + Human Generator 180 €/year — 15 ready-made humans/month, 1,000 priority generations, no watermarks, commercial use. Bulk purchase without a subscription, official volume price per photo: 1–20 photos 8 € each, 21–50 6 €, 51–250 5 €, 251–1,000 2 €, 1,000+ 1 € (official example: 100 photos = 579 €). A Monthly / Yearly −15% toggle is present; monthly list prices were not extracted and are left unlisted. Dataset and API prices are pointed to separately and were not recorded here.
